H2.rule: buy the side Jev favours when |pJev - price| >= 5 points; ask + 1c stress; taker fee

M1.rule: resting bids at the best bid on both tokens, back of the queue, fills only on trade-through or after the queue ahead is eaten; hold to resolution
M1.pass: >= 300 forward rounds with a fill and mean P&L per $ - 1.645 SE > 0

X1.rule: buy the side priced >= 5 points below the Deribit-implied chance (ask + fee + 1c); hold to resolution
X1.pass: >= 30 events with trades and per-event mean return - 1.645 SE > 0

E1.rule: at 3d before the scheduled end, buy the side priced 80-95c; history cost +2c, forward at the real ask +1c

M2.rule: quote both tokens for equal shares at the best bid (pair <= 99c), complete the pair after a fill, stop-loss 10c, flatten at 15% left; 250 ms latency, back of the queue
M2.pass: >= 300 rounds with a fill and mean P&L per $ - 1.645 SE > 0

K1.rule: Polymarket ask + opposite Kalshi ask + both taker fees + 1c per leg < $1; first gap per round, up to 5 pairs
K1.pass: >= 100 rounds with a gap trade and mean P&L per pair - 1.645 SE > 0

rivals.notes: read-only study of public accounts; P&L excludes their volume-tier taker rebates (up to 44-50% of taker fees at $4M-$10M monthly weighted volume)

R1.rule: replica of the observed rival pattern: take 5-share clips at the ask of whichever side keeps the pair cost <= 0.97; first leg <= 50c; through 2-95% of each 5m window; hold to settlement
R1.pass: >= 300 rounds with fills and mean P&L per $ (no taker rebate) - 1.645 SE > 0

wallet.guard: loss limit: -31.81 since the wallet started; no new entries

N1.rule: buy one YES of every outcome of a negRisk event when the basket costs < $1 after fees + 0.5c per leg; settle at resolution

S1.rule: buy the side priced 90-99.5c while a resolution proposal is live or after the scheduled end; settle at 1/0/0.5

M3.rule: join best bid and ask on ~20 liquid sports/politics markets, back of the queue, inventory skew; fills from real trades; maker rebate; mark to mid
M3.pass: >= 50 market-days with fills and mean P&L per market-day - 1.645 SE > 0

backfill.mode: record-only: past rounds from Polymarket public data

skillVsLuck.method: one-sided t (normal tail) on last 60 rounds, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, single-round concentration
